The '''Galactic City Medical Center''' was a [[Medcenter/Legends|medical facility]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was connected to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] [[Halls of Healing]] via high speed private transport for treatment of critical injuries.
